channel.title: Tunisia - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Tunisia, every source cited.

item.title: Tunisian official warns racist words can incite violence
item.description: Khémaïs Gharbi states that public discourse can make hateful speech acceptable and lead to violence.

item.title: Espérance sportive de Tunis plans strategic project
item.description: The Tunisian club will present its new initiative on January 15, 2027, its 108th anniversary.

item.title: Tunisia road accidents fall but fatalities rise
item.description: Road accidents in Tunisia decreased by nearly 10% by October 29, 2026, but the number of deaths increased by 13.19%.

item.title: Club Bizertin debt reduced by half
item.description: Ahmed Karoui's family offers to forgive 700,000 dinars of the club's 1.4 million dinar debt.

item.title: Tunisia transport attacks cost 4 million dinars
item.description: Attacks on trains, metros, and buses in 2025-2026 damaged property and affected 362 people, according to the transport minister.
